summary: The team debated interface control mechanisms and peripheral device compatibility, focusing on whether to implement an iPod-style touch disc and whether to support legacy VCR players alongside DVD players. Significant disagreements arose regarding the usability of touch-scroll navigation versus directional buttons, and the complexity of supporting international VCR standards versus a minimalist DVD design. Because consensus could not be reached within the allotted time, all decisions regarding the control disc and device compatibility were formally postponed to the subsequent meeting.
decisions: Formally postponed decisions on touch-wheel scroll navigation versus physical directional buttons due to lack of consensus
Deferred resolution on VCR versus DVD player compatibility to the next meeting pending further requirements clarification
